answer_1.quote: We pair each extracted anomalous image with annotations supporting three open-ended tasks: anomaly description, anomaly explanation, and anomaly justification.

answer_2.quote: We compute the precision, recall, and F1-score using these counts [...] evaluating a model's ability to predict the correct bounding box by computing the Intersection over Union (IoU) score.

answer_3.quote: We employ GPT-4o as a judge to assess whether two descriptions refer to the same anomaly [...] using an LLM judge, comparing model-generated and ground-truth explanations.

answer_4.quote: Due to the subjectivity of these criteria, we rely entirely on human evaluation [...] three annotators compare each model-generated justification with the human one and rate it.
answer_4.guideline: Rate justifications as better, similar, or worse across plausibility, relevance, and creativity
